internalNote: Built from western_lyre_1835_complete_extraction.csv, Kevin's own real per-song extraction (224 songs). Work's own firstEditionYear (1831) predates this specific edition (1835) - this is a later printing/edition of the same work, not the original. Page numbering runs 1-204 in the main body, followed by a lettered appendix (a1-a21) at the end - 21 additional songs, several without a listed meter, consistent with an appendix section in tunebooks of this era. One genuine gap in the main body's own page sequence: page 115 does not appear anywhere in the source CSV, between pages 114 and 116 - flagged rather than silently skipped, since this could be a blank page, an omitted page, or a genuine gap in the extraction itself; not resolved without checking the physical book or its scan. No song in this file has a key populated - the source extraction did not capture this field for this book, not a data-entry omission on any single song's part.
